1.explanation: We’re using Grommet v2.25.1’s PageHeader component inside a fixed-width Box (‘large’). By passing a single long string without spaces to the title (or heading) prop, the component cannot find a break point and thus overflows its container and the action button. This minimal example recreates the exact overflow and collision shown in the reported screenshot.
1.bug_scenario: A Grommet PageHeader is given a very long, single-segment string (no spaces) as its heading. Instead of wrapping to the next line when it runs out of horizontal space, the heading text overflows its container and collides with the right-hand action button.
